text:
Alex C: pushed a fixup for PR #4783 — addressed the prompt-test flake and factored the logging change into a follow-up commit. PTAL when you have a minute. Would like to get this into a Friday canary slot, any availability? CI currently shows: pending e2e.

Priya K: quick skim — really nice. lgtm on the flake fix. tiny nit: fmt on handler.go line ~112 (trailing comma). not blocking.

Miguel R: I can pickup that nit if you'd prefer to keep the PR as-is. Also FYI ops calendar: Friday morning is booked, but there's a late canary slot at 17:30 PT. happy to take it then.

Jamie: PTAL me for a final approve — want to run a local smoke before we push to canary. can you add a 1-line note in the PR description about the fallback behavior change? makes rollbacks easier.

Alex C: done — added commit 9a7b2c3 for the fmt nit and updated the PR description with the fallback blurb. ran a quick local smoke (no failures). kicking CI rerun.

CI-bot: triggered e2e pipeline for PR #4783 (run id: build-20260318-67). current status: running.

Alex C: thanks — pinging @Jamie and @Miguel when CI passes.

CI-bot: e2e pipeline completed: one flaky test failed on first run (tests/embedding_it::test_prefix_cache), re-run queued.

Alex C: re-run requested.

CI-bot: re-run finished — all checks green.

Miguel R: looked through the final diff, nothing else from me. approved.

Priya K: approved.

Jamie: ran the local smoke, looks good. approved. scheduling for the 17:30 PT canary slot. :rocket:

Alex C: fantastic — thanks everyone. I'll watch the canary and post back any regressions. If nothing odd shows up we can promote after the usual observation window.

Miguel R: thanks — i'll be on-call for the slot. ping me if the rollout hits the fallback path.

Alex C: will do.

CI-bot: deploy job started to canary cluster (slot 17:30 PT), watch logs at https://deploys.redwood.example/4783-canary

Alex C: posting the final checklist here: commits merged: 9a7b2c3 (nit), 4f2e1a0 (flake fix). PR desc updated. canary slot confirmed. all approvals present.

Priya K: great job moving quickly. :thumbsup:

Jamie: thanks all — closing thread.
